versions.changelog:
composition-eight-questions v0.1.0

- Initial release featuring the "八问法" (Eight Questions) approach for systematically enhancing photo composition and visual emphasis.
- Provides step-by-step guidance to help users make subjects stand out, increase visual impact, and avoid common composition pitfalls.
- Includes use cases, actionable checklist, and key distinctions from related skills such as photo evaluation and lighting direction.
- Outlines boundaries for when to (and not to) apply this method, plus known limitations from classic perspectives.
